response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and systems experience, there is no evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise framework (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) expertise — key requirements for the role. His work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only superficial Java exposure in past roles without context of IDE tooling or JVM internals.
strengths: Strong full-stack and systems engineering background across diverse platforms
Proven experience building developer tooling and open-source projects
Excellent communication and workshop leadership in technical communities
concerns: No demonstrated experience with Spring, Hibernate, or other enterprise Java frameworks
Lack of evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or JVM optimization work
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not Java/Kotlin as required
